The '''Imperial Office''' was a building located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], and used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
[[File:Ekirk.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Colonel Ekirk in his office.]]
The building served as the office of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Braedic Ekirk|Ekirk]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:CoA" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Galiir Ac Yandar]], the leader of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization known as the [[Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony]], visited the office in order to negotiate the integration of the N.S.H. in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] with Colonel Ekirk.<ref name="SWG:RI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Rebel Investigation|Talus}}</ref> In the meantime, [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer [[Dathnaeya Loessin]] sent a spacer to the office to work with Colonel Ekirk because she wanted to learn more about the ideologies and practices of the Empire and the Rebellion.<ref name="SWG:CoA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Office appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CoA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial Office was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Crisis of Allegiance|Crisis of Allegiance]]" arc with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref>
